text:
jen_sales: Quick summary for Sentinel POC run. Customer wanted mixed profile w/ short-chat heavy and occasional long generations. Ran 180 qps sustained with 20s microbursts to 420 qps. Key asks: pricing delta for a small reserved burst pool, and the completed security questionnaire (BYOK/KMS).

arun_se: please drop the exact command and whether KV cache and embedding batching were enabled. Also curious about model variant.

jen_sales: run command (runbot):
```
runbot start --target https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\ 
  --concurrency 180 --duration 600 \\ 
  --schedule "soak:180:600,burst:420:20@240s" \\ 
  --mix chat:0.7,embed:0.2,long:0.1 \\ 
  --model redwood/gptx-7b:v2-int8 --region us-west-2
```
KV cache: ON for chat. Embedding batching: OFF for baseline.

runbot: run_complete id=sentinel-2026-05-10 summary: qps=180 avg=140ms p95=260ms p99=1.5s max=3.8s errors=0.9% (mostly long-gen timeouts). Artifacts: https://internal.runs/sentinel-2026-05-10.json

paul_infra: infra notes: autoscaler saw spike and started provisioning at t+40s; vGPUs attached at t+130s due to allocation queue in region. Short burst window + cold attach explains p99 tail. Recommend either prewarm_nodes=1 or bump burst_window to 180s and enable embedding batching. Also consider a tiny reserved pool (2 nodes) for long-gen SLA.

arun_se: mitigation checklist for next run: 1) enable adaptive embedding batching (20-30ms), 2) burst_window_secs=180, 3) prewarm_nodes=1, 4) set long-gen timeout=12s. Snippet: {"adaptive_batching":"true","embedding_batch_ms":"25","burst_window_secs":"180","prewarm_nodes":"1","request_timeout_secs":"12"}.

claire_prod: customer requirement: p95 < 300ms mixed, p99 < 1s for short chat. Security asks: BYOK CMK with HSM-backed keys and SAML SSO note. I'll own the questionnaire.

jen_sales: action items: arun -> PR runbook w/ config and short how-to; paul -> post autoscale event timings and whether prewarm avoids cold attach; sales -> draft pricing delta (hosted per-token vs 2-node reserved pool) by EOD. runbot: marker?

runbot: marker: run_id=sentinel-2026-05-10 results_uploaded

jen_sales: thanks team, will consolidate and update Sentinel after infra and pricing confirmation. :)
